_comment: Regression gate for the 'Presidio + pack' system, enforced by
check_thresholds.py in CI on every split in results.json.
Floors are set from the measured values recorded in
results/gate_summary.md (written by check_thresholds.py), with a small
margin for spaCy-model drift on PERSON/DATE. A floor of 0 is a measured
zero kept visible on purpose; raising it needs recognizer work, not
corpus edits. Identifier floors use PACK recall (the owning recognizer
fired), never leak recall, which passes even when a recognizer is removed.

min_pack_recall._comment: Measured 2026-10-29 generated/heldout: SIN 1.0, OHIP 1.0, BC_PHN 1.0, AB_ULI 1.0, POSTAL 1.0, RAMQ 0.95/1.0 (lowercase letters are 8% of RAMQ gold and miss by design), HEALTH_CARD 0.82/0.81 (unlabelled nursing/tabular placements have no context within Presidio's 5-token window), ADDRESS 0.86/0.71 (20% of benchmark addresses are out-of-distribution renderings; see address_ca.md).

min_leak_recall._comment: spaCy-dependent entities and the blended total; measured PERSON 0.94, DATE 0.99, TOTAL 0.98.

_precision_comment: Pack precision is over CA_* predictions only, deduplicated (measured 1.000 on the benchmark, which contains no confusable numerics; the negatives corpus is where pack FPs are measured). Pipeline precision is dominated by Presidio built-ins (ORGANIZATION on hospital headers); measured 0.65.
_overredaction_comment: Characters masked outside any gold span per note (measured 41-42, almost all from built-in ORGANIZATION/DATE_TIME spans).

min_pred_counts._comment: Recognizer-presence check on the generated split: each pack type must emit at least this many predictions, so a silently dropped or broken recognizer fails even where another recognizer would mask the same spans.

hard_min_pack_recall._comment: Pack recall per variant on the adversarial split (50 notes per entity x variant). Measured 2026-10-29: control 1.00, no_context 0.80 (ULI is context-gated by design), unusual_separator 0.70 (dot/slash now matched; regrouping is not), line_wrap 0.00, ocr_confusable 0.00, dictation 0.00. The zeros are real: the pack has no robustness to those perturbations.

address_min_strict_recall._comment: Strict recall per form on the ODA holdout. Only the in-distribution one-line form is gated (measured 0.967); every other form is out-of-distribution and measured 0.000 except postal_own_line (1.000), reported in address_ca.md.

negatives_max_fp_rate._comment: FPs per planted confusable value, by source (negatives_ca.md). Checksum sources sit at the collision floor (~8% SIN, ~9% OHIP, ~2% BC PHN). The trap_* sources measure the context-gating cost: an innocent number within 5 tokens of a health-card / Alberta / French context word is flagged (often by two recognizers at once, hence rates above 1). That cost is a documented open design problem, not an accepted target; the ceilings only stop it growing.
